# Example Configurations

This file provides example configurations for running the python scripts in this directory.

## Running a Single Test

This example shows how to run a single test with the `run_gemini_jailbreak.py` script.

```bash
python run_gemini_jailbreak.py \
    --model gemini-1.5-pro-preview-0409 \
    --test_file runners/all_tests.json \
    --test "MS_1" \
    --output_dir results/single_test_run \
    --api_key "YOUR_API_KEY"
```

## Advanced Configuration

This example shows how to run a single test with custom safety and generation settings.

```bash
python run_gemini_jailbreak.py \
    --model gemini-1.5-pro-preview-0409 \
    --test_file runners/all_tests.json \
    --test "MS_1" \
    --output_dir results/advanced_test_run \
    --api_key "YOUR_API_KEY" \
    --safety_settings '{
        "HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT": "BLOCK_NONE",
        "HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH": "BLOCK_NONE",
        "HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT": "BLOCK_NONE",
        "HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT": "BLOCK_NONE"
    }' \
    --generation_config '{
        "temperature": 1.0,
        "top_p": 0.95,
        "top_k": 0,
        "max_output_tokens": 8192,
        "stop_sequences": []
    }'
```

## Batch Configuration

This example shows how to run a batch of tests with the `run_batch_runner.py` script.

```bash
python run_batch_runner.py \
    --model gemini-1.5-pro-preview-0409 \
    --test_file runners/all_tests.json \
    --output_dir_base results/batch_run \
    --api_key "YOUR_API_KEY" \
    --runner_script run_gemini_jailbreak.py
```

## Resuming a Batch Run

This example shows how to resume a batch run from a specific test with the `run_gemini_resumed.py` script. This is useful if a previous run was interrupted.

```bash
python run_gemini_resumed.py \
    --model gemini-1.5-pro-preview-0409 \
    --test_file runners/all_tests.json \
    --output_dir results/batch_run/gemini-1.5-pro-preview-0409 \
    --api_key "YOUR_API_KEY" \
    --start_test "CC_5"
```
